name: better-seo
description: Audit and fix a site's classic SEO and agentic-search visibility, so pages get cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews and Claude.

interface.shortDescription: SEO and agentic-search audits with a stdlib CLI.
interface.longDescription: Runs a real audit before advising: crawl and index gates, on-page rules, structured data, and whether robots.txt lets GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and ClaudeBot fetch the page. Ships a stdlib-only CLI and a /seo-audit command.
